name: Blossoming
description: On any kill, learn a new ability and take a new name. The prototype's one evolution trigger.

effects._note: Draws one ability not already held. Its on_gain effects fire immediately, so a stat boost lands this instant.

name: Swift Step
description: Passive: +2 Speed. Applied the moment it is learned.

name: Vengeful Bloom
description: On a kill, restore 6 HP. Bloodshed knits the wound.

name: Forest Ward
description: At the start of your turn, if standing in forest, restore 2 HP.

name: Mend Aura
description: At the start of your turn, restore 4 HP to each adjacent ally.
_note: The only source of active healing. Uses the heal_allies primitive; no self-heal, so the mender must be shielded.
